text_block_list.text: "...Once again this year, the city is gradually enveloped in the Christmas spirit."
Though it was being engulfed—

This year's Arima Kinen, in which Katsuragi Ace will run,
is scheduled to be held before Christmas.

Schedule-wise, Katsuragi Ace and I were
right in the middle of final preparations for the Arima Kinen.

Simply put, there was no time to get excited
about the looming Christmas atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Feels like she's shaping up nicely.
I can't wait for the Arima Kinen...!
choice_data_list: Well then, let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, about that—
after this, can I swing by the dorms once
and then drop by the trainer's office?"
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but did you want to consult me about something?
I don't mind, but did you need to talk about something?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just some personal business, I guess.
Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, catch you later~!
Afterward, while working in the trainer's office waiting for Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo.
Trainer-san, sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And with that, without further ado—
Here!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A bit early, sure,
but let's call it a Christmas present!
choice_data_list: Thanks! That's awfully sudden, though.
Thanks! That's pretty sudden, though.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give you this before the Arima Kinen.
Come on, open it up and take a look.

Urged on, I open the box to look inside,
and find a wristband with a sporty design...!
And looking closely, this coloring is—
choice_data_list: Could this match Ace's ear covers...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. That's right!
They're matching designs.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For the Arima Kinen, I just kinda wanted that feeling...
like Trainer and I are fighting together as one, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And then, I happened to see it in town and thought, 'This is it!'... so I gave it as a Christmas present, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
I know I'm the one who handed it over,
but isn't this actually kinda heavy!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! I got all hyped up on my own
and totally carried away!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer, if you don't want it, really—
choice_data_list: No!

text_block_list.text:
Right in front of Katsuragi Ace, I put on the wristband
and raised a clenched fist.
choice_data_list: How's it look? Do we feel like true partners?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Yeah! It looks super good on you!
choice_data_list: —Because I want to fight alongside you, Ace.
—Because I want to fight alongside you too, Ace.

text_block_list.text: "...This wristband truly makes me feel as though my heart is more strongly connected to Katsuragi Ace...!"
choice_data_list: So I'm really happy to get this. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...I really can't beat you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—If we win the Arima Kinen,
let's throw a huge victory party!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It can double as a Christmas party too!
choice_data_list: You're right!
You're right!

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Katsuragi Ace, I was able to spend
an early, modest, and heartwarming Christmas...
"Even so, a part of me started feeling that calling it a day right now would be such a waste—"
choice_data_list: Since we're at it, wanna go grab something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real?! Let's go, let's go!
Truth is, I'm super starving right now~!
choice_data_list: I'll treat you to anything! Think of it as an early Christmas!
I'll treat you to whatever you want! Consider it an early Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting!
Here's the Super Special Ramen MAX Bowl, gyoza, fried chicken,
fried rice, shumai, and spring rolls full combo—times three!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Woohoo~! This is the absolute best!!
choice_data_list: …Was our usual place okay?
…Was our usual place all right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
Isn't that more like us anyway?
choice_data_list: Guess so.
Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nooow then, time to dig in~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, you want something to eat?
I'll share, so take whatever you want!
choice_data_list: Well then—

text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent an early, modest, and warm Christmas
with Katsuragi Ace—filled with our usual peaceful calm...
